titleAr: غيّر الرقم الضريبي أو الاسم القانوني بعد التوثيق
titleEn: Change my tax number or legal name after verification

undo.note: the merchant can withdraw a pending request; the old verified state stays active until a super admin approves

ar: عايز اغيّر الرقم الضريبي بعد التوثيق
ازاي اعدّل الاسم القانوني في التسجيل الضريبي؟
en: How do I change my tax registration number after verification?
How do I change the legal name on my tax registration?
I entered the wrong tax number

steps: Open Tax & VAT, press Request a change
Enter the new number and legal name, attach the new tax card or certificate, press Review and send
Confirm; the request waits for Ebda AI Studio, your current verification stays active
edgeCases: Only a verified registration uses this flow; none, rejected and revoked edit and resubmit as before
One pending request per store; withdraw it to send another

The AI only reads the number and name off an image; plain code compares them with what was typed; a mismatch, an unreadable image, a PDF or an edited-looking image is flagged for the reviewer and never approved automatically
Approve, reject and revoke stay with a super admin; revoking drops a pending request
Edited payload or replayed confirm token is refused
